comments: The fix is non-trivial. We can't propagate the error back to the caller because the failing `bt_gatt_unsubscribe` operation is commanded by a special return value from `bt_gatt_subscribe_params.notify`. It's like we have a void function wrapper around `bt_gatt_unsubscribe`.

review_comments: Not related to this PR, but I have to say that this looks a bit awkward as an API, since it seems like it'd be trivial (and more clear & explicit) for the callback itself to do this `unsubscribe()` call rather than implying it through the return value.
I agree. I spelled it out in the function name to surface that awkwardness :)
I also agree - Maybe something we can avoid if we get a new GATT API for EATT
